d: Inhabited island in Baa Atoll, Maldives
x: Kendhoo is one of the inhabited islands of Baa Atoll, Maldives. It is located in the northern part of the Baa Atoll.

Baa Atoll is an administrative division of the Maldives. It consists of three separate natural atolls, namely southern Maalhosmadulu Atoll, the Fasdūtherē Atoll and the smaller natural atoll known as Goifulhafehendhu Atoll.

x: Thulhaadhoo is the second highest populated inhabited island of Baa Atoll.
Innamaadhoo is one of the inhabited islands of Raa Atoll in the Maldives.
Fainu is one of the inhabited islands of Raa Atoll. Fainu is situated in Raa Atoll which is officially known as North Maalhosmadulu Atoll. The island is located between the Kinolhas and Inguraidhoo.

Meedhupparu is a coral island on the east of the Northern Maalhosmadulu Atoll in the Maldives. Following the El Niño current that decimated the Maldives' surface coral in the late 1990s, the lagoon surrounding the island is full of dead coral, but is now interspersed with much new growth and the sea life is returning.
Rasmaadhoo is one of the inhabited islands in Raa Atoll, Maldives.
Meedhoo is one of the inhabited islands of Raa Atoll. The Raa Atoll Education Center is located in Meedhoo.
Hithaadhoo is one of the inhabited islands and third largest island with registered population of 1430 in Baa Atoll.
Kudarikilu is one of the inhabited islands of Southern Maalhosmadulhu Atoll.
Dhonfanu is one of the inhabited islands of Baa Atoll in the Maldives.

x: Maduvvari is one of the inhabited islands of Raa Atoll.
Maakurathu is one of the inhabited islands of Raa Atoll in the Maldives. Sultan Mohamed I is from Maakurathu. He is also the husband of Sultana Raadhafathi.
Kinolhas is one of the inhabited islands of the Raa Atoll administrative division of the Maldives.
Mudhdhoo, is an island in the Baa Atoll in the Maldives. It is the location of the Dusit Thani Maldives, a Dusit Thani Group resort hotel.

Landaa Giraavaru is an island in the Baa Atoll in the Maldives. The entire island has been home to the luxury Four Seasons at Landaagiraavaru resort since 2004. Operated by Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts, with rates from US$1,400 per night, it is one of the many island resorts of the Maldives.

d: Mosque in Eydhafushi, Baa Atoll, Maldives
x: The Al-Yoosuf Mosque is a Sunni Islam mosque, located in Eydhafushi, on the Baa Atoll, in the Maldives. The mosque opened in the 1970s, and accommodates 210 worshippers. The mosque was named after Yoosuf Kaleyfaanu.

Finolhas is an uninhabited island of the Baa Atoll, an administrative division and geographically part of Southern Maalhosmadulu Atoll of the Maldives. The island was previously inhabited and abandoned only during the reign of Sultan Hassan Nooraddeen I for unknown reasons.
